consent_scope_shape.name: consent_scope_shape
consent_scope_shape.value: ("consent_records"."scope" = 'family' and "consent_records"."child_id" is null) or ("consent_records"."scope" = 'child' and "consent_records"."child_id" is not null)

consent_grant_needs_assurance.name: consent_grant_needs_assurance
consent_grant_needs_assurance.value: "consent_records"."action" <> 'grant' or ("consent_records"."assurance_method" is not null and "consent_records"."assurance_evidence_reference" is not null)

session_controls_child_mode_shape.name: session_controls_child_mode_shape
session_controls_child_mode_shape.value: "session_controls"."mode" <> 'child' or ("session_controls"."active_child_id" is not null and "session_controls"."adult_gate_until" is null)

lesson_units_letter_shape.name: lesson_units_letter_shape
lesson_units_letter_shape.value: "lesson_units"."unit_type" <> 'letter' or ("lesson_units"."letter" is not null and char_length("lesson_units"."letter") between 1 and 16)

lesson_units_ayah_shape.name: lesson_units_ayah_shape
lesson_units_ayah_shape.value: "lesson_units"."unit_type" <> 'ayah' or ("lesson_units"."verse_source_id" is not null and "lesson_units"."verse_key" is not null)

lesson_versions_approved_shape.name: lesson_versions_approved_shape
lesson_versions_approved_shape.value: "lesson_versions"."status" not in ('approved','published') or ("lesson_versions"."reviewer_id" is not null and "lesson_versions"."release_hash" is not null)
